name: Spag
classification_notes: Spag is a geometric sans-serif where the primary design move is softening a geometric skeleton with rounded corners. It sits in the tradition of 1960s European display types, closer to rounded grotesque than Futura-derived purism. The Inline variant reinforces the display orientation.
summary: A soft geometric sans with 1960s sensibility, pairing strong geometric construction with rounded corner treatment.
description: Spag combines a geometric skeleton with softened rounded corners, referencing the rounded display types of 1960s European graphic design. Developed with art direction input from studio Arnhem Braun, it carries a mid-century warmth suited to editorial headers and brand identities. The Inline variant extends the family into more overtly display territory.
foundry_blurb: Spaghetype describes Spag as a soft sans-serif with strong geometric letter shapes and soft rounded corners, designed with the contribution of art direction studio Arnhem Braun and inspired by 1960s aesthetic. The Sofia Loren quote on the product page sets the tone: playful, warm, European.
